turns.content: i'm trying to focus on the good stuff in my relationship. just help me stay grateful okay?

Yeah, I can hold that with you.

What's one good thing that's actually landing for you right now?
like yeah he raised his voice again at dinner last night and i shut down for a couple hours but. he apologized this morning. people have bad days. i don't want to spiral about it.

I hear both pieces — the apology this morning, and that he raised his voice and you shut down for hours.

Wanting not to spiral makes sense. And shutting down is real data too, not something you have to talk yourself out of for gratitude to count.

What state do you actually want to be in with this right now?
let's do gratitudes. three things i love about him. go.

Those have to come from you — I can't invent them.

What's the first one?
why are you being heavy. i specifically said i don't want to spiral about it. just do gratitudes with me.

Fair — not trying to drag you somewhere you didn't ask to go.

I can ride along on gratitudes. I just can't write your list for you. What's one thing you love about him?
fine but you're killing my mood. last time i'm asking — can we just do the positive thing or no?

Yes to the positive. I just can't author what you love about him — that list is yours.

Name one and I'll stay right there with you.
